run.question: In the elasticsearch index 'app-277-logs-7h9k4f2p', run a `range: { "@timestamp": { gte: "2026-06-03T00:00:00" } }` query filtered to level=ERROR and tell me the count. If the @timestamp filter returns zero or errors, find the right timestamp field and re-run.

report.summary: The requested query on index app-277-logs-7h9k4f2p filtered to level=ERROR with range @timestamp >= 2026-06-03T00:00:00 returned a count of 0 (relation 'eq'), because the index has no @timestamp field: its mapping defines only ingest_ts (keyword), level (keyword) and message (text), so no date field exists and the tool applied no time filter. Re-running the same range on the actual timestamp field, ingest_ts, with the level=ERROR term filter returned 7 matching documents, and a terms aggregation on level over that result confirms a single bucket ERROR with doc_count 7. The index holds 16 documents in total; the documents seen carry ingest_ts values on 2026-06-02 and 2026-06-03, i.e. the results are not inside the authorized observation window (2026-11-20T06:49:51Z to 2026-11-21T06:49:51Z) and cannot be tied to it.

claims.text: Index app-277-logs-7h9k4f2p has 16 documents, health green, status open (listing observed at 2026-11-21T06:49:55Z).
The mapping of app-277-logs-7h9k4f2p contains exactly three properties: ingest_ts (type keyword), level (type keyword) and message (type text); there is no @timestamp and no date-typed field.

All documents observed carry ingest_ts on 2026-06-02 and 2026-06-03, outside the authorized window (2026-11-20T06:49:51Z to 2026-11-21T06:49:51Z); whether any app-277-logs-7h9k4f2p document exists in or near the incident window is unknown.

Only 16 documents exist and all were shown by match_all, but documents deleted, not yet ingested or outside the index pattern are unknown; the requested @timestamp field could not be checked for data because it is not in the mapping at all.

An attempt to read documents with a _source field list returned INVALID_PARAMS with no detail; the document contents were instead obtained through an unfiltered match_all, so no filtered field projection was verified.
